title: Honest question for people who trade or have tried bots: which of these four would you actually try?
author: Euphoric_Opposite298
selftext:
I'm sketching a free tool and before building more I want to know if the idea is understood. Not selling anything, no links. Four descriptions of the same thing:



A) Before you put a single euro into a bot or a strategy, check it for free with real data and real fees.

B) A lab where the bots people sell you are replayed candle by candle over real years, to see how much they would have made and lost.

C) Build your strategy with blocks, no code, test it with paper money over real years and compete in a weekly league.

D) Tell your own AI (ChatGPT, Claude, whichever you use) the strategy you have in mind and test it with paper money over real years before you trade it.



Two questions, answer with the letter:

1. Which one did you understand on first read?

2. Which one would you try if it were free?

If you think it already exists and you use it, tell me which one, that helps too. Thanks.
